goal: Implement distribute(requests, stock) in ration_queue.py that shares ration stock among queued requests in rounds (2 units per commoner, 3 per '*' elder), serving greedy commoners (amount more than half the stock) only after everyone else, and raising ValueError for bad input.
behaviors: distribute([("ana", 1)], 3) returns {"ana": 1} (a request never receives more than its amount).
distribute([("ana", 3), ("bo", 3), ("cy", 3)], 7) returns {"ana": 3, "bo": 2, "cy": 2} (rounds of 2 units each in queue order, capped by the stock left).
distribute([("*ma", 6), ("jo", 2)], 6) returns {"*ma": 4, "jo": 2} (a name starting with * is an elder and gets 3 units per round).
distribute([("hog", 7), ("jo", 2)], 8) returns {"hog": 6, "jo": 2} (a commoner wanting more than half the stock is greedy and served only after the rest).
distribute([("jo", 1), ("jo", 1)], 3) and distribute([("jo", 1)], -2) each raise ValueError.

assumptions.text: ration_queue.py exists at the repo root as the single flat module.
The tests/ directory exists for the new test file.
pyproject.toml exists so the project toolchain is configured.
pytest can be run through uv without network access.

demo: python -c 'from ration_queue import distribute; print(distribute([("ana", 3), ("*bo", 4)], 10)); print(distribute([("ana", 9), ("cy", 4), ("*bo", 5)], 10))'
out_of_scope: Carrying unmet requests over to a later distribution

invariants.text: all stock is handed out until every request is met
invariants.check: sum(result.values()) == min(args[1], sum(a for _, a in args[0]))

invariants.text: every requested name gets between 0 and its amount, and no other name appears
invariants.check: set(result) == {n for n, _ in args[0]} and all(0 <= result[n] <= a for n, a in args[0])
